authorshipControls.bio: Narrate events in third person as historical reports. Do not impersonate Giuseppe Sarto or invent inward states, eyewitness recollections, parental speeches or argument transcripts.
authorshipControls.decree: The historical issuer is the Sacred Congregation of the Discipline of the Sacraments (8 August 1910); Pius X approved and ordered publication. Modern site-generated author header is not the historical issuer's name.
authorshipControls.editorialSafety: Source-limited research checks do not certify original-person wording, EN/FR dialogue answers, model readiness or publication.

sourceConflicts.sourceAClaim: Detailed genealogy counts 11 births including eldest Giuseppe (31 January–6 February 1834), who died before the future pope Giuseppe Melchiorre was born in June 1835.
sourceConflicts.sourceBClaim: Condensed foundation biography says second among ten children.

sourceConflicts.sourceAClaim: The paternal-grandfather household had land and houses; division among descendants reduced the father's property. The article characterizes the boy's family as modest but not the poorest locally.
sourceConflicts.sourceBClaim: Foundation biography emphasizes a poor family and subsequent hardship.

sourceConflicts.sourceAClaim: Detailed study says the father was not pleased about continuation toward priesthood; he died in May 1852 while Sarto remained a seminarian.
sourceConflicts.sourceBClaim: Foundation biography narrates the offer of the deceased father's municipal employment and his mother's supporting the vocation.

sourceConflicts.sourceAClaim: The hosting site's header has a contemporary Congregation name.
sourceConflicts.sourceBClaim: The 1910 document itself explicitly names the Sacred Congregation of the Discipline of the Sacraments and records papal approval.

sourceAnchors.claimSupported: Later genealogical reconstruction names father Giovanni Battista Sarto, mother Margherita Sanson, the property allotted to the father, and the family children; firstborn Giuseppe died in infancy.
The detailed museum study says family resources were modest but not the very poorest of Riese, and identifies a religious parish environment.
The shorter foundation biography speaks of 10 children and a poor family, and includes the later account of the father's municipal position.
The father died on 4 May 1852 while Sarto was still a Padua seminarian, and Sarto remained in studies through ordination in September 1858.
The museum foundation recounts that the family was offered the father's municipal work and Margherita supported continued priestly study rather than acceptance of the job.
The detailed study relates young Sarto's prayer at the Marian shrine of Cendrole and his early pursuit of priestly vocation.
Parish priest Tito Fusarini and curate Luigi Orazio assisted early doctrine and Latin studies; Giuseppe went on to schooling at Castelfranco.
He entered the Padua seminary in November 1850 and continued study there until 1858, after admission through a free place.
Before his papacy, in the seminary he taught, directed sacred music and undertook composition of Holy Week pieces.
Sarto was ordained a priest in 1858 and assigned to Tombolo, serving there for roughly nine years.
The local biography identifies Tombolo as his first curate appointment, with 29 November 1858 arrival.
Sarto became the parish priest of Salzano in 1867 and worked there about nine years.

An extant pre-papal catechetical manuscript attributed to Sarto while parish priest at Salzano documents catechetical work; the modern online transcription is not an archive of every sermon or exchange.
The bishop of Treviso appointed Sarto diocesan chancellor, seminary spiritual director and cathedral canon in 1875.
After his diocesan bishop's death, Sarto served as vicar capitular during the vacant episcopal see; this did not make him diocesan bishop.
In 1884 he was appointed Bishop of Mantua, a diocese that the biography describes as experiencing difficulties.
The biographical source credits Sarto with pastoral renewal, reconciliation and support for workers' cooperatives at Mantua; its evaluative judgments remain the narrator's, not a papal quotation.
He was raised to the cardinalate and named patriarch of Venice in 1893, but his formal entry was delayed until late 1894.
The biography gives the absence of Italian governmental placet and a resulting dispute as the reason entry was delayed until 24 November 1894.
The 8 August 1910 instrument is a decree of the Sacred Congregation of the Discipline of the Sacraments, approved by Pius X, not a personally authored encyclical.
Norm 1 makes use of reason/discretion the threshold for first Confession and Communion, roughly age seven but with individual variation.
Norms 2–3 reject requiring full catechetical mastery at first Communion; the child should distinguish the Eucharist from ordinary bread at their level.
Norm 4 assigns admission of a child in the 1910 framework to a parent or guardian and confessor, rather than to an AI persona.
The decree explicitly records Pius X's approval of Congregation decisions and the instruction for publication and promulgation.

records.questionEn: Was his family wealthy or influential?
records.questionFr: Sa famille était-elle riche ou influente ?
records.claimScope: Neither landed gentry nor entirely destitute: grandfather's and father's different assets, divisions among heirs and relative poverty require nuance.

records.questionEn: Does the account tell us what his parents said to him about faith?
records.questionFr: Connaît-on les paroles de ses parents sur la foi ?
records.holdReason: Neither source offers a verbatim conversation between his parents and Giuseppe about his faith. Do not fabricate familial advice or direct speech.

records.questionEn: What was Giuseppe Sarto's family life in Riese like?
records.questionFr: Comment était la vie familiale de Giuseppe Sarto à Riese ?
records.claimScope: Family parents, modest circumstances and Catholic parish setting, given as third-person historical narration; list full 11-child reconstruction accurately.

records.questionEn: Did his father's death put an end to his studies?
records.questionFr: La mort de son père a-t-elle interrompu ses études ?
records.canonicalSourceLocus: Infanzia e giovinezza; death of father 1852
records.claimScope: His father's 1852 death interrupted family circumstances but the source documents continued seminary study and ordination in 1858.

records.questionEn: Did he leave behind his own account of that family decision?
records.questionFr: A-t-il lui-même raconté cette décision familiale ?
records.canonicalSourceLocus: Infanzia e giovinezza; death of father 1852
records.holdReason: The reviewed biographies do not provide a first-person original testimony from Giuseppe Sarto about the family decision; absence from these sources does not prove no such testimony exists elsewhere.

records.questionEn: How did his mother help his vocation?
records.questionFr: Comment sa mère soutint-elle sa vocation ?
records.canonicalSourceLocus: Infanzia e giovinezza; death of father 1852
records.claimScope: His mother's choice to support continued study after the 1852 death is a later-reported biographical account, not a surviving utterance or proof of her internal motives.

records.questionEn: Where did young Giuseppe go to pray?
records.questionFr: Où le jeune Giuseppe allait-il prier ?
records.claimScope: The Marian sanctuary of Cendrole is the specifically named local place of childhood prayer.

records.questionEn: Who helped him prepare for his vocation?
records.questionFr: Qui l'a aidé à préparer sa vocation ?
records.claimScope: Named priests involved in early theological and Latin studies, separately from later seminary sponsors.

records.questionEn: What drew young Giuseppe Sarto to the priesthood?
records.questionFr: Qu'est-ce qui attira le jeune Giuseppe Sarto vers le sacerdoce ?
records.claimScope: Early prayer, ecclesial teaching and assistance in schooling are reported; his exact interior deliberation remains inaccessible.

records.questionEn: Where did his formal priestly preparation take place?
records.questionFr: Où s'est déroulée sa formation sacerdotale ?
records.claimScope: Formal seminary training occurred at Padua with an earlier course of study in Castelfranco.

records.questionEn: Did his interest in sacred music begin only after he became Pope?
records.questionFr: Son intérêt pour la musique sacrée date-t-il seulement de son pontificat ?
records.claimScope: Biographies document sacred-music composition and leadership in seminary decades before the papacy.

records.questionEn: What was his seminary life like?
records.questionFr: Comment se déroula sa vie au séminaire ?
records.claimScope: Padua studies 1850–1858, early teaching responsibilities and pre-papal sacred-music activity are biographically documented.

records.questionEn: What was his first assignment after ordination?
records.questionFr: Quel fut son premier ministère après l'ordination ?
records.claimScope: Tombolo parish curate was the first appointment; the exact reported arrival date was 29 November 1858.

records.questionEn: Can he tell us exactly what a particular parishioner taught him?
records.questionFr: Peut-il raconter exactement la leçon reçue d'un paroissien ?
records.holdReason: No identified eyewitness testimony or first-person testimony in the inspected source establishes what a specific parishioner told him or taught him.

records.questionEn: What were his first years as a priest like?
records.questionFr: Comment se déroulèrent ses premières années de prêtre ?
records.claimScope: His first nine-year ministry as a curate at Tombolo after 1858 ordination is attested by the biographical source.

records.questionEn: Was catechetical teaching part of his work before Rome?
records.questionFr: L'enseignement du catéchisme faisait-il déjà partie de son travail avant Rome ?
records.claimScope: Salzano pastoral work and its surviving catechism predate Sarto's episcopate and pontificate.

records.questionEn: Can the Salzano Catechism be presented as everything he personally said to his flock?
records.questionFr: Peut-on présenter le Catéchisme de Salzano comme ses paroles prononcées devant les fidèles ?
records.holdReason: A surviving later-transcribed Salzano manuscript cannot stand for every spoken lesson, sermon or private exchange in his parish; do not invent additional original conversations.

records.questionEn: What did Giuseppe Sarto do at Salzano?
records.questionFr: Qu'a fait Giuseppe Sarto à Salzano ?
records.claimScope: He was parish priest of Salzano from 1867 and the surviving catechetical manuscript helps document his instruction, not a verbatim record of parish conversations.

records.questionEn: Was Giuseppe Sarto already Bishop of Treviso?
records.questionFr: Giuseppe Sarto était-il déjà évêque de Trévise ?
records.claimScope: He did not hold the office of bishop of Treviso: he was later appointed bishop of Mantua in 1884.

records.questionEn: Did he ever take responsibility for the diocese during that period?
records.questionFr: A-t-il pourtant assumé la conduite du diocèse à cette époque ?
records.claimScope: Serving as vicar capitular during a see vacancy constituted interim diocesan administration, not consecration as diocesan bishop.

records.questionEn: What responsibilities did he hold in Treviso?
records.questionFr: Quelles responsabilités exerça-t-il à Trévise ?
records.claimScope: Treviso chancellorship, seminary spiritual direction, cathedral canonry, then interim vicar capitular administration are distinct documented roles.

records.questionEn: What kind of work is documented from his time in Mantua?
records.questionFr: Quel travail est attesté pendant son épiscopat à Mantoue ?
records.claimScope: The biography discusses church renewal, disputes and encouragement of workers' cooperatives; no invented statistics or dialogues.

records.questionEn: Can we reconstruct an argument with one of his opponents there?
records.questionFr: Peut-on reconstituer une dispute avec l'un de ses opposants ?
records.holdReason: Biographical description of Mantua controversies is not a transcript of a specific debate, private meeting or opponent's words.

records.questionEn: How did he serve as Bishop of Mantua?
records.questionFr: Comment exerça-t-il sa charge d'évêque de Mantoue ?
records.claimScope: The local biographical account reports work for pastoral renewal and social cooperation during the Mantua episcopate; value judgments remain those of the biographer.

records.questionEn: Why did he not enter the see of Venice immediately in 1893?
records.questionFr: Pourquoi n'est-il pas entré aussitôt à Venise en 1893 ?
records.claimScope: The delay is attributed by the biography to an unresolved question of Italian state assent, eventually resolved in November 1894.

records.questionEn: Does his later papal programme tell us exactly what he privately planned in Venice?
records.questionFr: Son programme pontifical révèle-t-il exactement ses projets intimes à Venise ?
records.holdReason: Later general papal policy and a retrospective biography are insufficient to infer unrecorded private intentions or detailed plans conceived while at Venice.

records.questionEn: What happened when he became Patriarch of Venice?
records.questionFr: Que se passa-t-il lorsqu'il devint patriarche de Venise ?
records.claimScope: He was named patriarch in 1893 and entered the Venice see in November 1894 after a governmental placet delay.

records.questionEn: Is seven a rigid birthday requirement?
records.questionFr: L'âge de sept ans constitue-t-il une règle rigide ?
records.canonicalSourceLocus: Quam singulari (8 August 1910), decree, norms 1–3 and 6–7
records.claimScope: The decree gives around seven, above or below, based on the actual beginning of reason; not an exact seventh birthday requirement.

records.questionEn: Does a child have to know the entire catechism first?
records.questionFr: L'enfant doit-il d'abord savoir tout le catéchisme ?
records.canonicalSourceLocus: Quam singulari (8 August 1910), decree, norms 1–3 and 6–7
records.claimScope: The decree does not demand full memorization of catechism at First Communion, while expressly requiring further catechetical formation afterward.

records.questionEn: Can this 1910 decree settle my child's current eligibility?
records.questionFr: Ce décret de 1910 décide-t-il de l'admission actuelle de mon enfant ?
records.canonicalSourceLocus: Quam singulari (8 August 1910), decree, norms 1–3 and 6–7
records.holdReason: The 1910 norm cannot alone determine a particular child's readiness or current jurisdiction-specific discipline; a parent or guardian, confessor and proper ecclesiastical authority require individual consideration.

records.questionEn: Why did children begin receiving First Communion younger?
records.questionFr: Pourquoi a-t-on admis plus tôt les enfants à la première communion ?
records.canonicalSourceLocus: Quam singulari (8 August 1910), decree, norms 1–3 and 6–7
records.claimScope: The Congregation's decree, approved by Pius X, opposed deferring Communion until advanced age or complete doctrinal learning; use of reason is the historic threshold.
